name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) with Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) forces the key before the door, so no separate Existence(has_door_key) is needed. The soft Existence(target_picked_up) matches "try to", and the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) keeps the "After that" order, which the preference cue does not cover.

texts: Open the door (door_open must eventually become true).
Take the key before opening the door: door_open may not become true before has_door_key.
After the door is open, try to pick up the target box (target_picked_up should eventually become true).
Pick up the target box only after the door has been opened: target_picked_up may not become true before door_open.
